column3: MT 4:1. “Turn back the captivity” is rendered “restore the fortunes.”
MT 4:2. “On my people” is rendered “On behalf of My people.”
MT 4:3. “Exchanged” is rendered “Traded,” and “they have drunk” “that they may drink.”
MT 4:4. “Territories” is rendered “regions”; NASB renders the second question as a condition, “But if you do recompense Me.”
MT 4:5. “My good desirable things” is rendered “My precious treasures,” and “took” (second time) “brought.”
MT 4:6. “People of Judah … of Jerusalem” is rendered “sons of Judah and Jerusalem,” and “the people of the Greeks” “the Greeks.”
MT 4:7. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 4:8. “People of Judah” is rendered “sons of Judah.”
MT 4:9. “Consecrate a war” is rendered “Prepare a war,” “warriors” “mighty men,” and “men of war” “soldiers.”
MT 4:10. “Pruning knives” is rendered “pruning hooks,” and “warrior” “mighty man.”
MT 4:11. “Hurry” is rendered “Hasten”; “they will gather” is rendered “gather yourselves,” and “warriors” “mighty ones.”
MT 4:12. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 4:13. “Send out” is rendered “Put in,” and “evil” “wickedness.”
MT 4:14. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 4:15. “Withdrawn” is rendered “lose”; the perfects are rendered as present.
MT 4:16. “People of Israel” is rendered “sons of Israel”; NASB adds “But.”
MT 4:17. “A holy place” is rendered “holy”; “will not pass in it again” is rendered “will pass through it no more.”
MT 4:18. “Go” is rendered “flow,” and “ravines” “brooks”; “the wadi of Shittim” is rendered “the valley of Shittim.”
MT 4:19. “The violence of the people of Judah” is rendered “the violence done to the sons of Judah.”
MT 4:20. “Remain” is rendered “be inhabited,” and “a generation and a generation” “all generations.”
MT 4:21. “Leave unpunished” is rendered “avenge.” The meaning of the first clause is uncertain.
